card.name: Alas and other split-up names
card.fires_on: The word "alas" (or its first piece "Al") in old folk tales, and the middle piece of unusual names such as ZTAL-MY or Ay-utthaya.

modes.label: Alas in tales
modes.description: The exclamation "alas" in translated folk stories.

modes.label: Inside rare names
modes.description: A piece partway through an unusual brand or place name, such as ZTALMY or Ayodhya.
modes.example: Administer ZTAL<<MY>> orally three times daily with food.

card.plain: It fires on the old-fashioned cry "alas" and on the middle of odd, rare names.
